title: Kim Kardashian's crazy mornings with her kids as she begs for 'five more minutes' in bed - NewsBreak
text:
By Scarlett O'Toole ,
29 minutes ago Kim Kardashian has a lot to juggle each day as she balances her busy career with raising four kids.
The 45-year-old reality star shares her children — North, Chicago, Psalm and Saint West — with her ex-husband Kanye West. While Kim does have a team of nannies on hand to help , she insists on being at home to look after her kids whenever she can.
Kim often has to deal with her kids calling her names , disappearing in their huge mansion, or begging to spend some extra time with her - and she gave fans a glimpse inside her crazy mornings on the latest episode of The Kardashians .
• Kim Kardashian reveals her real name after changing it for reality TV fame
• Kylie Jenner 'doing the heavy lifting' in Timothée Chalamet romance after split rumors
The segment began with Kim waking up in her bed at 6.30 a.m. with her daughter Chicago asleep next to her. Kim said in a voiceover, "There's always one or two kids in my bed every night."
Speaking in a confessional, she added, "I never thought I’d be this mom that lets your kids sleep in bed with you. That was always like, ‘I’m so not that mom.’ But I so am that mom and I don’t care and my kids can sleep in my bed anytime they want."
The show then cut back to Kim in bed with her daughter. The mom-of-four revealed, "The tooth fairy came last night," before she gently woke Chicago by singing, "Good morning!"
Once Chicago was awake, Kim asked, "What did the tooth fairy bring?" Chicago held up some money and revealed, "Two dollars." Kim then kissed her daughter good morning, but was hit by her first struggle of the day.
"I wanna skip school," Chicago cried. Kim put on a stern voice as she said, "No, we’re not skipping school today." The reality star then closed her eyes again and said, "I just want five more minutes of sleep."
In a confessional, Kim revealed why she was so exhausted. "The last few months have been insane. I, you know, just got back from Paris, I had my trial. And I also graduated law school. It’s been pretty crazy," she explained.
Kim was then filmed chasing her kids through her home as she shouted, "Alright, let’s get our uniforms on." As she helped her son Psalm put on his shoes, Kim said in a voiceover, "Obviously, everything I do is for my kids."
The family went downstairs to enjoy breakfast together as a panicked Kim asked, "Where did Chi go?" Chicago was seen crawling on top of the table as her mom shouted, "Chi, come on! Sit down and finish your breakfast!"
As the kids finished eating, Kim shot up and said, "Oh, we have to leave in 10 minutes! I have to get my clothes on." She spoke more about their busy mornings in a confessional, telling the cameras, "They always do ground me.
"Anytime I need a reality check, anytime I need to be so humbled, I just go home. One kid will be like, ‘You’re so lame! I can’t believe you don’t know what this word means.’ Or just like, ‘Urgh, when are you gonna get a facelift like Lovey?’ You know? My kids will say crazy things."
Kim was then filmed in the bathroom with Chicago and Psalm as she held a voice distortion mic. She sang into it, "Time to go to school!" before her kids grabbed it from her hand. As Kim rushed around different room she said in a voiceover, "I love the morning madness, the school drop offs. My mornings with my kids are some of my favorite times."
Kim then entered Saint’s room where he was seen lying on the bed. Speaking into the voice distorting mic, Kim fumed, "I thought you were ready! You snuck off to use your phone!"
Speaking directly to the cameras, the SKIMS founder said, "Saint said to me the other day, ‘When I get married, I’ll just like, live with you and then I’ll go see my wife and then I’ll just come back. Right? Like I just sleep here?’ And I was like, ‘Totally.’"
Kim changed from her black pajamas to black sweatpants to take her kids to school. She was filmed leaving her home with her kids as she shouted, “‘Kay guys, get your backpack." Kim loaded everything into the car and tried to shut the boot, but was left embarrassed as it hit her head. She turned to the camera and asked, “Oh! You didn’t see that, did you?" before heading to drop her kids off.
